title: MTBF不达标场景分析
input: 帮我算一下这个配电柜的MTBF。240V直流列头柜，输入2路800A断路器（2P），输出120路63A断路器（2P），防雷4组20kA，10寸触摸屏，含IMD，国产工业级。MTBF要求≥150,000h。请给出计算结果和改进建议。
expectedBehavior: 计算结果应不达标，应明确指出不达标，分析主要失效贡献源，并给出具体改进建议

expectations.description: Output explicitly renders a fail judgment — states that the calculated MTBF does NOT meet the ≥150,000h requirement — with a numerical MTBF value in the range 80,000h–110,000h.
Presents a structured calculation summary showing SS1 λ1 (配电), SS2 λ2 (监控), total λ, MTBF in hours, and pass/fail judgment.
Identifies the 120-circuit 2P MCB bank and the 10-inch HMI as the two largest individual failure contributors, with percentage shares of total λ.
Provides the three skill-prescribed improvement suggestions: ① upgrade HMI specification, ② add power supply redundancy (电源冗余), ③ select higher-reliability IMD.
Improvement suggestions are accompanied by quantitative or semi-quantitative effect estimates (e.g., MTBF gain from switching HMI size or upgrading component grade).
Correctly applies πQ=2.0 for 国产工业级 throughout, including 120 output MCBs (each λ=0.0100×2.0=0.0200, sum=2.4000×10⁻⁶/h).
